audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer sides read Skill on rows 0 and 1 while the content layer and packet levelChart both read Orianna.
audit.why: 52.34% over 642 games. Levels 1-2 are Orianna's: Tangle-Barbs is not yet a reliable root and Neeko has to walk into 815 range to do anything, so the passive-stacked autos win the contact. From level 3 the root chains Blooming Burst and the lane is a genuine skill fight until two items.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and phases[1].side set to Orianna with both whys rewritten to say why.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.spikes said level 6 'doubles your lane presence' with no mention of Pop Blossom.
audit.why: Level 6 here is two area ultimates pointed at each other: Pop Blossom is 120/105/90 at 600 range with a leap, knockup and stun, and its preparation is hidden while she is disguised. Shockwave is 110/95/80. Whoever lands theirs first takes the fight, which is exactly why the row is Skill.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and breakdown.spikes rewritten around the two ultimates and the hidden wind-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to sidestep the root 'behind minions', never mentioned that the disguise breaks on damage or CC, and never mentioned that Pop Blossom's wind-up is invisible while disguised.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10, 1000 range) becomes larger, faster and roots for longer if it kills an enemy or passes through a champion — so a dying minion in its path upgrades the root instead of eating it. Inherent Glamour (P) breaks on immobilizing crowd control, on Neeko casting a damaging spell, or on the disguise taking damage equal to its health bar, which means one Command: Attack through a suspicious ally exposes her and a Shockwave breaks it outright. Pop Blossom (R, 120/105/90, 600) hides its preparation while she is disguised. Blooming Burst (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, 800) blooms a second time only when it hits a champion or kills a unit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now carry the 12s root that grows off a dying minion, and the hidden ultimate wind-up.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/E/R text, cooldowns and ranges

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it; packet reports zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs at 12s rank 1 and Pop Blossom at 120s rank 1 are the two timers that decide when you may step forward.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with both numbers and an explicit step-in cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko is female and the full layer addressed her as he/his in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.trading, breakdown.wave, six phase whys, three do/don't titles and report[0]/[1]/[3]/[4]/[11]. dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were also foreign strings pasted under their titles.
audit.why: champ-gender lists neeko as female; the third person on this page is the enemy.
audit.corrected: Regendered throughout, and the two bled bullets rewritten to match their titles.
